body.name: IAM
body.description: Roles and Groups. People request, review, grant and remove access, and manage eligible and active privileged roles. Effective assignments always come from the protected Access source.

permissions.label: Request access
permissions.description: Allows creating and submitting access requests.

permissions.label: Manage IAM
permissions.description: Administrative management of the IAM application.

text.value: Access requests and reviews describe intent and decisions. Only protected Access determines current people, roles, groups and assignments; those views read live protected Access data and are never copied into records.
Read live from protected Identity and Access data under your current authority; nothing is copied into application records.
Read live from protected Identity and Access data under your current authority; nothing is copied into application records.
Read live from protected Identity and Access data under your current authority; nothing is copied into application records.

Revise a role's label and description, create an empty Group, rename a Group, or end a role, Group or Group membership. Each change runs under your own authority in protected Access, is checked against the revision you read, and is refused if you lack the authority. Granting access is never done from here.

End a role assignment, a role activation or a delegation authority. Each change runs under your own authority in protected Access, is checked against the revision you read, and is refused if you lack the authority. Granting, assigning and activating access are never done from here.
Privileged roles the current person may activate are not yet available from a protected read model.
Privileged roles currently active for the current person are not yet available from a protected read model.
